records.jp: これは……
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: え？　えっ？<CR>詩さん、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Hm? What's wrong, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? What's wrong, Uta?
records.en: Hm?<CR>What's wrong, Uta-san?

records.jp: 星崎さんから、なんだか……<CR>いい匂いがします
records.en_original: I just thought that you smell very nice, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought that you smell very nice, Ao.
records.en: I just thought that you smell very nice,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: うーん、シャンプーの香りかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... Maybe it's my shampoo?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Maybe it's my shampoo?
records.en: Hmm... Maybe it's my shampoo?

records.jp: シャンプーですか？　でも……
records.en_original: Your shampoo? But...
records.en_auxiliary: Your shampoo? But...
records.en: Your shampoo? But...

records.jp: みんな同じものを使ってるはずなのに、<CR>私のとは違う香りがしますよ？
records.en_original: We all use the same shampoo, why do you smell different?
records.en_auxiliary: We all use the same shampoo, why do you smell different?
records.en: We all use the same shampoo,<CR>why do you smell different?

records.jp: うっ、するどい。<CR>さすがにシャンプーじゃごまかせないか……
records.en_original: Urk, you're sharp. I guess it can't be because of the shampoo...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk, you're sharp. I guess it can't be because of the shampoo...
records.en: Urk, you're sharp.<CR>I guess it can't be because of the shampoo...

records.jp: それって、紅茶の香りじゃない？<CR>さっき作業室で飲んだから
records.en_original: Could it be tea you're smelling? I was drinking some in the work room earlier.
records.en_auxiliary: Could it be tea you're smelling? I was drinking some in the work room earlier.
records.en: Could it be tea you're smelling?<CR>I was drinking some in the work room earlier.

records.jp: 紅茶？
records.en_original: Tea?
records.en_auxiliary: Tea?
records.en: Tea?

records.jp: 確かに、かすかに紅茶の香りがしますね。<CR>でも、それだけじゃなさそうです
records.en_original: There's definitely a hint of tea, but there's something else.
records.en_auxiliary: There's definitely a hint of tea, but there's something else.
records.en: There's definitely a hint of tea,<CR>but there's something else.

records.jp: ぎくっ
records.en_original: Ack!
records.en_auxiliary: Ack!
records.en: Ack!

records.jp: もっと甘くて濃厚で、<CR>でも少し香ばしいような……？
records.en_original: Something sweet like...vanilla?
records.en_auxiliary: Something sweet like...vanilla?
records.en: It is sweeter and richer,<CR>but also slightly toasty somehow...

records.jp: わ、わかったわかった！<CR>白状しますぅ！
records.en_original: Okay, I got it! I'll spill the beans!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, I got it! I'll spill the beans!
records.en: Okay, I got it!<CR>I'll spill the beans!

records.jp: いい匂いの正体は、これ！<CR>焼きたてマドレーヌ！
records.en_original: It's coming from these. Freshly-baked madeleines!
records.en_auxiliary: It's coming from these. Freshly-baked madeleines!
records.en: It's coming from these.<CR>Freshly-baked madeleines!

records.jp: ああ、お菓子の匂いだったんですね。<CR>言われてみれば、バターとお砂糖の香り……
records.en_original: Oh, it really was a dessert. The buttery smell certainly makes more sense now.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it really was a dessert. The buttery smell certainly makes more sense now.
records.en: Oh, it really was a dessert.<CR>The buttery smell certainly makes more sense now.

records.jp: 作業室で詩帆さんと鉢合わせて、<CR>こっそり分けてもらったんだよね
records.en_original: I bumped into Shiho earlier and she snuck me some.
records.en_auxiliary: I bumped into Shiho earlier and she snuck me some.
records.en: I bumped into Shiho-san<CR>earlier and she snuck me some.

records.jp: ちょうど２つあるから、詩さんも一緒に食べようよ。<CR>はい、どーぞ！
records.en_original: I just happen to have two, so let's eat them together! Here!
records.en_auxiliary: I just happen to have two, so let's eat them together! Here!
records.en: There happen to be two, so let us eat them together, Uta-san.<CR>Here you go!

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>……やっぱり、いい匂い
records.en_original: Thank you. Oh, they smell delicious.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. Oh, they smell delicious.
records.en: Thank you.<CR>It really does smell nice...

records.jp: あはっ！<CR>詩さん、口元が笑ってる
records.en_original: A-ha! Uta, you're smiling!
records.en_auxiliary: A-ha! Uta, you're smiling!
records.en: A-ha!<CR>Uta-san, you're smiling!

records.jp: す、すみません
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sorry...
records.en: I-I'm sorry...

records.jp: 謝ることじゃないって！<CR>お菓子の匂いをかぐと、私もにこにこしちゃうもん
records.en_original: Don't apologize! I get all smiley when I smell delicious treats too!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't apologize! I get all smiley when I smell delicious treats too!
records.en: Don't apologize!<CR>I get all smiley when I smell delicious treats too!

records.jp: 詩さんもほしい？<CR>ちょうど２つあるし、美味しそうだもんね？
records.en_original: Would you like one, Uta? I have two. Don't they look good?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you like one, Uta? I have two. Don't they look good?
records.en: Would you like one, Uta-san?<CR>I have two. Don't they look good?

records.jp: いえ、別に。<CR>それは星崎さんのものですから
records.en_original: No, I'm fine. Those are yours, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I'm fine. Those are yours, Ao.
records.en: No, I'm fine.<CR>Those are yours, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: まさかのお断り……
records.en_original: Turned down...
records.en_auxiliary: Turned down...
records.en: Turned down...

records.jp: じゃあ、おやつタイムしたい私のために<CR>１つもらってくれない？
records.en_original: What about if I told you that you'd be doing me a favor if you shared these with me?
records.en_auxiliary: What about if I told you that you'd be doing me a favor if you shared these with me?
records.en: Then would you take one for my sake,<CR>since I want to have snack time?

records.jp: それが、星崎さんのためになるんですか？
records.en_original: And that would help you?
records.en_auxiliary: And that would help you?
records.en: And that would be good for you, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: なるなる、すっごくなるよ！
records.en_original: Yeah, totally!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, totally!
records.en: Yeah, totally!

records.jp: なら、頂きます。<CR>……ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Then I'll have one. Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: Then I'll have one. Thank you.
records.en: Then I'll have one.<CR>Thank you.

records.jp: でも、いいんですか？<CR>星崎さんがもらったものなのに、私に渡してしまって
records.en_original: Are you sure this is okay? Shiho didn't give these to me...
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure this is okay? Shiho didn't give these to me...
records.en: But is that really okay?<CR>They were given to Hoshizaki-san, and you are giving one to me.

records.jp: いいのいいの！<CR>だって……
records.en_original: It's perfectly fine, I promise! Besides...
records.en_auxiliary: It's perfectly fine, I promise! Besides...
records.en: It's perfectly fine, I promise!<CR>Besides...

records.jp: せっかくのマドレーヌだよ？<CR>ふたりで食べたほうが美味しいからね
records.en_original: We don't get madeleines every day! Snacks like this are always better shared between friends.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't get madeleines every day! Snacks like this are always better shared between friends.
records.en: They are special madeleines, after all.<CR>They will taste better if we eat them together.

records.jp: 何人で食べても、<CR>マドレーヌの味は変わりませんよ？
records.en_original: The taste shouldn't change no matter how many people are eating it.
records.en_auxiliary: The taste shouldn't change no matter how many people are eating it.
records.en: The taste shouldn't<CR>change no matter how many people are eating it.

records.jp: それはそうなんだけど、なんていうか……
records.en_original: That's true... How do I say this...
records.en_auxiliary: That's true... How do I say this...
records.en: That's true... How do I say this...

records.jp: 詩さんと食べたって事実が<CR>最高のスパイス……みたいな？
records.en_original: The time I spend with you is sweeter than any dessert...or something.
records.en_auxiliary: The time I spend with you is sweeter than any dessert...or something.
records.en: The fact that I ate it with you,<CR>Uta-san, is the best seasoning... or something?

records.jp: ごめんなさい、よく分かりません。<CR>でも……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I don't completely understand.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, I don't completely understand.
records.en: I am sorry, I do not really understand.<CR>But...

records.jp: 星崎さんとマドレーヌを食べたって事実が<CR>悪くはないものだってことは、分かる気がします
records.en_original: Though I think I can understand the appeal of enjoying a snack with a friend.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I think I can understand the appeal of enjoying a snack with a friend.
records.en: I think I understand that the fact I ate a<CR>madeleine with you is not a bad thing, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: ふふ、そっか！
records.en_original: Haha! Good!
records.en_auxiliary: Haha! Good!
records.en: Haha! Good!

records.jp: 詩さんの笑顔が見たいから！
records.en_original: I just wanna see you smile more!
records.en_auxiliary: I just wanna see you smile more!
records.en: Because I want to see you smile, Uta-san!

records.jp: ……私、そんなに面白い顔で笑ってますか？
records.en_original: Is my smile so strange?
records.en_auxiliary: Is my smile so strange?
records.en: Is my smile so strange?

records.jp: 面白いっていうか、しみじみする！<CR>詩さん、マドレーヌ食べてるなあ……って
records.en_original: Rather than strange, it's... affecting? It makes it seem like you're really enjoying your madeleine.
records.en_auxiliary: Rather than strange, it's... affecting? It makes it seem like you're really enjoying your madeleine.
records.en: It isn't funny, exactly—it's moving!<CR>Like, 'You really are eating a madeleine, Uta-san...'

records.jp: しみじみ……？　よく分かりませんが、<CR>星崎さんはそれを楽しんでるんですね
records.en_original: Affecting? I don't really know what you mean, but it sounds like you enjoy it.
records.en_auxiliary: Affecting? I don't really know what you mean, but it sounds like you enjoy it.
records.en: Moving...? I don't really understand,<CR>but you seem to be enjoying it, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: なら私も、マドレーヌを食べながら<CR>星崎さんを観察することにします
records.en_original: In that case, I'll observe you while we eat as well.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, I'll observe you while we eat as well.
records.en: Then I'll observe you while I eat my madeleine too,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: か、観察かあ……ま、いいや。<CR>私のしまりのない顔でよければ、いくらでもどうぞ！
records.en_original: O-observe? O-okay... You're free to admire me get my chomp on as much as you like!
records.en_auxiliary: O-observe? O-okay... You're free to admire me get my chomp on as much as you like!
records.en: O-observation, huh...? Well, all right.<CR>If you do not mind my slack-jawed face, look as much as you like!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
